quest.title: This Novel Seems... Problematic?
quest.description: Shigeru, an editor at the Yae Publishing House, seems to be facing an unprecedented crisis.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Have you read the reader feedback? Our reviews have been plummeting lately!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Don't worry. This is just the calm before the grand climax!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: When the key plot point gets revealed, we'll see a real turnaround in those reviews!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: And what good is that if your novel gets axed long before you get there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Traveler, thank goodness you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Junkichi has been adding a lot more wild abilities to the main character, in "Onibudou." It's just been one thing after another ever since that "inspiration trip" of his.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Yae Publishing House has received a lot of negative feedback from readers who say they don't understand why these abilities are appearing. They think that the author isn't taking the story seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: They don't know what they're talking about. I'll just keep writing, they'll get it at some point...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Like I was saying, your novel will get axed before you can get to that point!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Oh, whatever... From what I recall, there are a few readers of "Onibudou" around this area...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Why don't you go and ask them if your idea has legs or not?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Fine! I'm sure they'll get it, anyway. Traveler, come with me. I'll need a witness!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Yes, that sounds good. Bring the Traveler with you. That way, you can't deny what they say later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Okay, let's get going. I'm sure my readers will understand me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How much feature creep is there, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Just... just a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: "A bit"? The main character will soon have more abilities than every other character in the story combined!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Ahem! Let's get going. I'm sure my readers get it!

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Hello, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there. Have you read "Onibudou," by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Huh? I have and I liked it, but... How should I put it? The plot seems a little strange lately.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: The main character is constantly getting new abilities and can immediately defeat the enemy with them.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: I liked "Onibudou" because of the clever methods the main character used to defeat his enemies, but now... it feels like the author is just being lazy.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Also, most of the abilities the main character gets are only used once. It makes the story seem so... flippant.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: I really don't know what the author is thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Ahem... well... let's ask a few more people, shall we? This has got to be an odd case...

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: Hello, is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, there is. Have you ever read "Onibudou"?

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: Yes, I have! It's a very interesting novel. The characters and the plot are wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: But... I feel like the author has been slacking off a bit lately.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Uh... Um...

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: There are all these new powers that suddenly appear without having ever been referenced before.

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: Although it's called an "awakening," it just seems cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Hasegawa
dialogues.text: I just think this kind of cheap plot makes the character look cheap too. I really hope the author reconsiders this course...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Traveler, let's... let's go ask someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Hi there, are you up for a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Indeed. Have you read "Onibudou," by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: I have. I like the main character a lot, too.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: But I've been having a hard time reading it lately...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A hard time?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: In the last few chapters, the main character was suddenly bestowed with all these new abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: The story spends a lot of time talking about how those abilities were awakened and how they can be used.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: And the names of those abilities are getting harder and harder to follow. I can't remember any of them.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: If I keep reading, I don't think I will be able to follow the story without understanding these abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: *sigh* I was thinking of giving the book a rest and switching to something a little easier to follow.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Uh... Let's...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's head back...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Okay... I don't get why this is happening...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Alright then, how did it turn out? Did you get the readers'...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: ...Wait, why does he look so depressed... what kind of feedback did you get?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: *sigh*... So, Junkichi, will you accept the feedback now?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I can't believe it... How did this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Are my ideas... and my writing... not interesting enough?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: As I said, advancing the plot purely by giving the character new powers can be dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: The new traits might be momentarily popular, but as soon as the novelty wears off, the readers will get bored.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: This is years of experience talking, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I—I know...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: It's not too late to change it, though... We can't reverse the reviews of the previous chapters, but we can get the following chapters back on solid footing...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. It's actually better to let him take a hit now. If he kept on writing like that, he would definitely be worse off overall.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: So, thank you. This is your payment. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Traveler, I'm counting on you. Please record their opinions honestly!
